# GoDaddy
> GoDaddy provides domain registration, hosting, websites, email, security, and commerce tools for individuals and businesses.

GoDaddy’s web presence spans product documentation, developer APIs, help content, investor information, newsroom updates, and legal resources. This file highlights the most useful structured entry points for language models and agents.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://www.godaddy.com/): Main entry point for GoDaddy products, services, and account access.
- [Domains](https://www.godaddy.com/domains): Domain search, registration, transfers, and domain management offerings.
- [Websites + Marketing](https://www.godaddy.com/websites/website-builder): Website builder and online marketing tools for small businesses.
- [Web Hosting](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/web-hosting): Shared hosting plans and hosting product overview.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/wordpress-hosting): Managed WordPress hosting plans, features, and setup options.
- [Email & Microsoft 365](https://www.godaddy.com/email/professional-business-email): Professional email and Microsoft 365 business email offerings.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.godaddy.com/web-security/ssl-certificate): SSL certificate products for website encryption and trust.
- [Online Store](https://www.godaddy.com/websites/online-store): Ecommerce storefront tools for selling products and services online.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://www.godaddy.com/help): Central support hub for products, billing, and account management.
- [Domain Names Help](https://www.godaddy.com/help/domain-names): Help articles for domain registration, DNS, transfers, and settings.
- [Websites + Marketing Help](https://www.godaddy.com/help/websites-marketing): Support for website builder, marketing, and online store tools.
- [Hosting Help](https://www.godaddy.com/help/hosting): Support content for hosting plans, setup, and troubleshooting.
- [WordPress Help](https://www.godaddy.com/help/wordpress): Help articles for managed WordPress hosting and administration.
- [Email Help](https://www.godaddy.com/help/email): Support for Microsoft 365 email setup, migration, and troubleshooting.
- [Security Help](https://www.godaddy.com/help/security): Help content for SSL, website security, and related protection products.
- [Account Management Help](https://www.godaddy.com/help/account-management): Guidance for sign-in, profile, payments, and account settings.

## Developer
- [Developer Portal](https://developer.godaddy.com/): Main portal for GoDaddy APIs, documentation, and developer onboarding.
- [API Documentation](https://developer.godaddy.com/doc): Reference and guides for GoDaddy developer APIs.
- [Domains API](https://developer.godaddy.com/doc/endpoint/domains): API endpoints for domain availability, purchase, and management workflows.
- [Shopper API](https://developer.godaddy.com/doc/endpoint/shoppers): API endpoints for shopper accounts and customer-related operations.
- [Agreements API](https://developer.godaddy.com/doc/endpoint/agreements): API methods for retrieving legal agreements required during purchases.
- [Countries API](https://developer.godaddy.com/doc/endpoint/countries): API endpoints for country and geographic metadata.
- [Order API](https://developer.godaddy.com/doc/endpoint/orders): API endpoints for order creation and commerce-related operations.
- [Support and Resources](https://developer.godaddy.com/resources): Additional developer resources, support, and platform information.

## Domain Management
- [Domain Search](https://www.godaddy.com/domains/domain-name-search): Search for available domain names across extensions.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.godaddy.com/domains/domain-transfer): Transfer existing domains to GoDaddy registrar services.
- [Domain Auctions](https://auctions.godaddy.com/): Marketplace for expired and investor-focused domain name auctions.
- [WHOIS](https://www.godaddy.com/whois): WHOIS lookup for domain registration and ownership details.
- [Broker Service](https://www.godaddy.com/domains/domain-broker): Domain broker service for acquiring already-registered domains.
- [Domain Value Appraisal](https://www.godaddy.com/domain-value-appraisal): Domain valuation tool for estimating market value.
- [Premium Domains](https://www.godaddy.com/domains/premium-domain-names): Premium domain inventory for high-value domain purchases.

## Hosting and Infrastructure
- [Web Hosting](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/web-hosting): Shared hosting product overview and plan comparison.
- [VPS Hosting](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/vps-hosting): Virtual private server hosting plans and infrastructure options.
- [Dedicated Servers](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/dedicated-server): Dedicated hosting for higher-performance workloads and control.
- [Managed WordPress](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/wordpress-hosting): Managed WordPress hosting with maintenance and performance features.
- [Reseller Hosting](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/reseller-hosting): Hosting reseller plans for agencies and service providers.
- [cPanel Hosting](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/cpanel-hosting): Linux hosting plans with cPanel management tools.
- [Windows Hosting](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/windows-hosting): Windows-based hosting plans for ASP.NET and Microsoft workloads.

## Websites and Commerce
- [Website Builder](https://www.godaddy.com/websites/website-builder): No-code website creation tools for businesses and creators.
- [Online Store](https://www.godaddy.com/websites/online-store): Ecommerce website tools for catalog, checkout, and payments.
- [Managed WooCommerce Stores](https://www.godaddy.com/hosting/woocommerce-hosting): WooCommerce hosting tailored for WordPress ecommerce stores.
- [Digital Marketing Suite](https://www.godaddy.com/websites/marketing): Marketing tools for social, email, and customer outreach.
- [Appointments](https://www.godaddy.com/websites/appointments): Online appointment booking tools for service-based businesses.
- [POS and Payments](https://www.godaddy.com/payments): Payment processing and point-of-sale solutions for merchants.

## Email and Security
- [Professional Email](https://www.godaddy.com/email/professional-business-email): Business email plans using custom domains and Microsoft 365.
- [Microsoft 365](https://www.godaddy.com/email/microsoft-365): Microsoft 365 plans for email, productivity, and collaboration.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.godaddy.com/web-security/ssl-certificate): SSL certificate options for securing websites and transactions.
- [Website Security](https://www.godaddy.com/web-security/website-security): Malware scanning, monitoring, and website protection services.
- [Managed SSL Service](https://www.godaddy.com/web-security/managed-ssl-service): Managed SSL deployment and renewal support.
- [Backup](https://www.godaddy.com/web-security/website-backup): Website backup and restore tools for data protection.

## Company and News
- [About GoDaddy](https://aboutus.godaddy.net/): Corporate overview, leadership, governance, and company information.
- [Investor Relations](https://investors.godaddy.net/): Financial reports, SEC filings, governance, and investor updates.
- [Newsroom](https://www.godaddy.com/resources/news): Company announcements, press releases, and media updates.
- [Careers](https://careers.godaddy/): Job listings, culture information, and hiring resources.
- [GoDaddy Blog](https://www.godaddy.com/resources): Articles, guides, and business insights for entrepreneurs.
- [Venture Forward](https://www.godaddy.com/ventureforward): Research and data on microbusinesses and entrepreneurship.

## Legal and Policies
- [Legal Agreements and Policies](https://www.godaddy.com/legal/agreements): Central index of GoDaddy legal agreements and policies.
- [Universal Terms of Service](https://www.godaddy.com/legal/agreements/universal-terms-of-service-agreement): Core terms governing use of GoDaddy services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.godaddy.com/legal/agreements/privacy-policy): Privacy practices for data collection, use, and sharing.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.godaddy.com/legal/agreements/cookie-policy): Information about cookies and tracking technologies.
- [Domain Registration Agreement](https://www.godaddy.com/legal/agreements/domain-name-registration-agreement): Terms specific to registering and maintaining domain names.
- [ICANN Information](https://www.godaddy.com/legal/icann): ICANN-related notices, rights, and registrar information.
- [Trust Center](https://www.godaddy.com/trust-center): Security, privacy, compliance, and platform trust information.
